subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Ancient Warehousing
description: Learn Ancient Warehousing in one minute.

hook.text: Egyptian pharaohs stored grain in massive silos to survive seven-year famines. The first warehouses.

buildup.text: Ancient civilizations learned that survival depended on storing surplus—food, tools, and seeds.

discovery.text: Mesopotamian temples doubled as warehouses, with clay tablets tracking every item in and out.

twist.text: These inventory records are the oldest written documents. Accounting was born from warehousing.

climax.text: The principle hasn't changed: store when you have plenty, use when you don't. Buffer against risk.

punchline.text: Warehousing is as old as civilization itself.

quiz.question: What were the earliest written documents?
